description: Independent second reading for the KiDS-1000 v2 package (item 11 of REPRODUCTION_REV3.md), frozen before the first v2 conversion run. Files read from the public GitHub mirror rstpier/EFF_G_GALAXIES at commit 7606a21d5e7118b49ec57aef79d357da87118346, because the canonical tarball is refused by the workspace proxy; the README hash is checked against the tarball in CI (item 12). The covariance reading transcribes a non-redistributable release file, so it is not committed: the conversion regenerates it with reading/scripts/read.py from the fetched release and must match the hash under off_repo.
